scope: Sweep allocations reached inside the AC1024 OBJECTS callback while emitting typed ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY and ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY records.

source.profile: The base dependency profile has class version 3, status -7, read/attached flags, dependency order -2, present name allocation-retry, null dependency references, and body id -9. The value-dependency profile adds class version 0, name VALUE_DEPENDENCY, and a real value 12.5.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate each record profile in ASCII and Binary. Inject std::bad_alloc at every reached callback offset; require failed whole-file publication, byte-identical destination sentinel preservation, caller-object preservation, same-codec retry, and fresh DXF typed readback of the base and value-dependency fields.

validation.ascii: Base dependency: 6/6; value dependency: 8/8 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
validation.binary: Base dependency: 6/6; value dependency: 7/7 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated serialization and transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native associative semantics are established.
The value dependency control covers only one AC1024 real-valued source profile; integer values, geometry dependencies, reference graph closure, and whole-drawing conversion remain outside scope.
nextAction: Add allocation rollback/retry coverage for a typed AC1024 ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY profile only if its graph prerequisites can be represented and read back without broad adapter preflight injection; keep source and graph semantics independently gated.
